description: This file defines the CommandHandlerWrapper class, which encapsulates command handling logic for a device and optional gateway, providing methods for handling commands and remote close events.

classes.name: CommandHandlerWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that manages command handlers for a specific device and gateway, including remote close handling.

methods.name: CommandHandlerWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with device ID, optional gateway ID, command handler, and optional remote close handler.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID associated with this handler.

methods.name: getGatewayId
methods.description: Returns the gateway ID associated with this handler, or null if not specified.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Delegates command handling to the encapsulated command handler.

methods.name: handleRemoteClose
methods.description: Invokes the remote close handler if it exists.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the wrapper including device and gateway IDs.
